observations: Photo 0: Open laptop showing Windows login screen, screen displays blue abstract wallpaper, keyboard has red backlight, MSI logo visible below screen, stickers for Intel Core i7 and NVIDIA GeForce RTX on palm rest.
Photo 1: Close-up of keyboard and touchpad, red backlight visible, Intel Core i7 and NVIDIA GeForce RTX stickers present, surface shows dust and minor smudges.
Photo 2: Closed laptop lid, black matte finish, embossed MSI dragon logo, small white sticker with '84291' written on it, visible scratches and smudges on lid surface.
No photos of ports, hinges, screen bezel, or underside.
No visible model number or serial number in any photo.

claims.evidence: No model number visible in any photo; only MSI logo is readable. The seller's text claims the model, but no photo confirms it.
Screen resolution and refresh rate cannot be confirmed from photos alone; no on-screen display or settings visible. IPS-level is a specification claim not verifiable remotely.

risks.risk: The laptop may not be the claimed model (MSI Katana GF66 11UE)
risks.proof: Photo of the model label or serial number sticker, typically found on the bottom of the laptop or inside the battery compartment.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic MSI gaming laptop, not the specific model, which may be worth less.

risks.risk: Screen may not have 144Hz refresh rate or IPS-level panel
risks.proof: Screenshot of display settings showing refresh rate, or a video showing screen performance with fast motion to test for motion blur or tearing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard 60Hz or 120Hz laptop, not a 144Hz gaming display.

risks.risk: Laptop may have physical damage not visible in photos (e.g., hinge wear, cracked screen, dead pixels, internal damage)
risks.proof: Video showing full 360-degree rotation of the laptop, close-up of screen for dead pixels, and hinge flex test.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential hidden damage, reducing value.

risks.risk: Keyboard backlight may not be fully functional or may have dead keys
risks.proof: Video showing all keys lit and pressed in sequence, including function keys and number row.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having possible backlight or key failure.

proof_requests: Photo of the bottom of the laptop showing the model label or serial number.
Screenshot of display settings showing refresh rate and resolution.
Video showing full 360-degree rotation of the laptop, including hinge and screen.
Video showing all keyboard keys lit and pressed.
response.reason: The model cannot be confirmed from the photos, and key specifications like refresh rate and screen type are unverifiable. Hidden risks such as physical damage, dead pixels, or non-functional keys cannot be ruled out. Without proof of the model and condition, a worst-case price cannot be confidently assigned.
